name: converge
_comment: Refine-loop happy path (`review --iterate`): round 1 arbiter=NEEDS_REVISION → reviser revises → round 2 arbiter=STRONG → REVIEW_COMPLETE (converged at iteration 2). Reviewer/arbiter lists are indexed per call, so entry [0]=round1, [1]=round2. Run WITHOUT --iterate this ends REVIEW_COMPLETE after round 1 (one-shot critique).
